label: 📋 Copy Ad · WHITE & REPAIR review + arrows v1
brief: COPY AD — REFERENCE = Fang bad-breath ad (benefits with hand-drawn arrows around a centred product, tagline under it). Build a LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR ad with THIS layout,
genPrompt:
COPY-AD REMAKE. The FIRST attached image is a proven, high-spending competitor Facebook ad. Recreate it as a NEAR-IDENTICAL remake for LACALUT White & Repair (German pharmacy oral care). Target: a viewer who saw both would say "same ad, different brand". KEEP EXACTLY (do not reinterpret, improve, re-compose or add to): the layout grid and every zone's position and size, the background, scene, props, people, poses, crops, camera angle, lighting, colour-blocking, type hierarchy, type sizes, text positions, alignment, badges, arrows, stickers, borders and overall finish. If it is a flat graphic, stay flat; if it is a photo, stay photographic; if it is UGC / lo-fi, stay lo-fi. BACKGROUND COLOUR — MANDATORY CHANGE (the ONE thing that is ALWAYS different from the reference): replace the reference's dominant background / card colour with light silver-grey #E9EBEE to platinum grey #D9DCE1 (LACALUT White & Repair brand grey) — NEVER green, sage, blue or cream. Keep the same background TYPE (flat card stays a flat card, gradient stays a gradient, photo scene stays a photo scene with its surfaces re-tinted toward this colour), same texture and lighting — only the hue changes. Re-tint any panel borders, pills or outlines that matched the old background so they still sit naturally on the new one. Text colours stay as the reference unless contrast fails, then darken/lighten minimally. SWAP ONLY: (a) their product → the attached LACALUT reference packshot, placed in the SAME spot, SAME scale, SAME angle and SAME lighting as their product (if their product is held, ours is held the same way); (b) their brand name, logo and wording → the LACALUT wording below. Where a line is marked "keep", reproduce it exactly; where it is rewritten, keep the SAME size, weight, colour, case and position for the new words. 

PRODUCTION SPEC OF THE REFERENCE AD (follow literally — this is the layout and copy to rebuild):
1. CANVAS
1.1. Aspect ratio: 1:1 (square).
1.2. Overall style: Flat graphic background with realistic product photography/render and props.
1.3. Dominant background: Solid light mint green/teal color.

2. LAYOUT GRID
2.1. Top headline and stars zone: Approximately 22% of canvas height.
2.2. Middle product, props, and feature callouts zone: Approximately 56% of canvas height.
2.3. Bottom product name and tagline zone: Approximately 22% of canvas height.

3. TEXT
3.1. "I'm not worried about" - Top zone, large size, medium weight, title case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, left aligned.
3.2. "bad breath" - Top zone, large size, bold weight, title case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, left aligned.
3.3. "anymore." - Top zone, large size, bold weight, sentence case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, left aligned.
3.4. "Helps control plaque buildup" - Left middle zone, small size, regular weight, sentence case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, left aligned.
3.5. "Supports long-term oral health" - Left middle zone, small size, regular weight, sentence case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, left aligned.
3.6. "Freshens breath naturally" - Right middle zone, small size, regular weight, sentence case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, right aligned.
3.7. "nature + science" - On upper part of product tube, tiny size, regular weight, lowercase, dark grey color, sans serif font style, centered.
3.8. "powered by n-HA & pure natural extracts" - On upper part of product tube, tiny size, regular weight, lowercase, dark grey color, sans serif font style, centered.
3.9. "Gently Remineralises" - On middle part of product tube, tiny size, regular weight, title case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, left aligned.
3.10. "Anti-Cavity" - On middle part of product tube, tiny size, regular weight, title case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, left aligned.
3.11. "Anti-Plaque" - On middle part of product tube, tiny size, regular weight, title case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, left aligned.
3.12. "Anti-Sensitivity" - On middle part of product tube, tiny size, regular weight, title case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, left aligned.
3.13. "120 gm / 4.23 oz e" - On lower part of product tube, tiny size, regular weight, sentence case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, left aligned.
3.14. "fang" - Vertically oriented on the right side of the product tube, small size, regular weight, lowercase, dark grey color, sans serif font style, centered vertically.
3.15. "Fang Toothpaste" - Bottom zone, medium size, bold weight, title case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, centered.
3.16. "Confidence starts with your smile." - Bottom zone, small size, regular weight, sentence case, dark grey color, sans serif font style, centered.

4. PRODUCT
4.1. What it is: A white toothpaste tube with a silver/light grey screw cap.
4.2. Where it sits: Centered horizontally, positioned in the middle zone, slightly below the vertical midline of the canvas.
4.3. Approx % of canvas height: Approximately 60-65%.
4.4. Angle: Front-on view, with a slight tilt to the right.
4.5. Lighting: Soft, even, and bright lighting from the front-top.
4.6. Shadow/reflection: A subtle, soft drop shadow directly beneath the base of the tube. No visible reflection.
4.7. Held or standing: Standing upright.

5. PEOPLE / PROPS / SCENE
5.1. Props: A small cluster of fresh green mint leaves.
5.2. Position: Located at the bottom center of the canvas, in front of the base of the toothpaste tube.
5.3. Camera angle and lens feel: Eye-level perspective for the product, with a clean, slightly wide feel for the overall composition.

6. GRAPHIC DEVICES
6.1. Stars: Five solid, bright yellow, 5-point stars. Positioned horizontally centered below the main headline "I'm not worried about bad breath anymore."
6.2. Arrows: Three dark grey, curved line arrows with distinct arrowheads.
6.2.1. Top left arrow: Originates near the top left side of the toothpaste tube, curves left and then downwards, pointing towards the text "Helps control plaque buildup".
6.2.2. Bottom left arrow: Originates near the bottom left side of the toothpaste tube, curves left and then upwards, pointing towards the text "Supports long-term oral health".
6.2.3. Right arrow: Originates near the middle right side of the toothpaste tube, curves right and then downwards, pointing towards the text "Freshens breath naturally".

7. COLOUR PALETTE
7.1. Background: Light mint green/teal (e.g., #D0F0E8).
7.2. Primary text and arrows: Dark grey (e.g., #333333).
7.3. Stars: Bright yellow (e.g., #FFD700).
7.4. Product tube: White (e.g., #FFFFFF).
7.5. Mint leaves: Fresh green (e.g., #4CAF50).

8. MOOD / FINISH
8.1. Lighting: Bright, soft, and evenly diffused, creating a clean and fresh aesthetic.
8.2. Contrast: Moderate contrast, ensuring readability of text and clear definition of product against the background.
8.3. Photo vs render: The toothpaste tube and mint leaves appear to be high-quality product photography or realistic 3D renders, integrated onto a flat graphic background.
8.4. Any filter or grain: No noticeable filters, grain, or textures; the finish is smooth and clean, conveying a modern and clinical mood.

CHANGES REQUESTED BY THE ART DIRECTOR (the ONLY deliberate differences from the reference — apply exactly, nothing more):
REFERENCE = Fang bad-breath ad (benefits with hand-drawn arrows around a centred product, tagline under it). Build a LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR ad with THIS layout, 4:5 portrait. TEXT SIZE BEATS IMAGE SIZE: every text line big and bold, readable at thumbnail size.
BACKGROUND: soft light silver-grey #E9EBEE to platinum #D9DCE1 (NEVER green, sage, blue or cream), subtle soft glow behind the product, dark navy #12284C text and LACALUT red #C8102E highlight words.
TOP, FULL WIDTH (edge to edge with small side margins, about 36% of the height, the whole card including its bottom rows): the FIRST EXTRA attached image is a finished Facebook comment card (white card, avatar, grey bubble, bold name, FIVE GOLD STARS under the name, long review text, reaction pill with count, "2w Like Reply", "View 6 replies"). Use it EXACTLY as supplied INCLUDING the bottom rows "2w  Like  Reply" and "View 6 replies" which MUST stay visible (never crop them off, never trim the card), pixel-copied, never redrawn, retyped, re-spelled - every word and element identical - only scaled up to span the full width.
MIDDLE (about 40% of the height): the attached product image (the SECOND image) = LACALUT white & repair toothpaste tube (grey design) leaning behind-left and the white mouthwash bottle in front-right, together. Place EXACTLY as supplied, centred, pixel-copy both packs, do NOT redraw, rotate, flip, mirror or add products. FOUR hand-drawn curved arrows in dark navy, each from a benefit label to the product, labels BOLD dark navy, large; the words in [RED] are LACALUT red #C8102E, everything else navy:
 - Left, upper (arrow to the tube): "Gently lifts [RED]coffee & tea stains[/RED]"
 - Left, lower (arrow to the tube): "Helps [RED]remineralise tooth enamel[/RED]"
 - Right, upper (arrow to the bottle): "[RED]Brighter-looking[/RED] smile with every rinse"
 - Right, lower (arrow to the bottle): "[RED]Smoother[/RED], stronger-feeling teeth"
BOTTOM (about 20% of the height): headline in heavy bold dark navy, centred, THREE LINES, VERY LARGE: line 1 "Don't Ignore" line 2 "Stained, Weak Enamel." line 3 "Give Them The German Care." Leave clear breathing room between the headline and the bottom-right corner. The SECOND EXTRA attached image = the real LACALUT "100 YEARS" logo (red, lips mark, "DENTAL EXPERTISE SINCE 1925"): BOTTOM-RIGHT CORNER, small (about 18% of the canvas width), pixel-copied exactly, never redrawn, clear of the headline (no overlap). Leave a small empty space immediately to the LEFT of the logo.
NO stars row outside the review card, NO Trustpilot, NO headline above the review, NO CTA button, NO price. Remove all Fang branding and the "Tap to learn more" / FANGORAL link bar.

LACALUT PRODUCT (from the SECOND attached image onward): reproduce the real packaging EXACTLY — shape, label layout, colours, logo and wording; real proportions (a tall slim 75ml tube, never squat); only the LACALUT wordmark and variant name may read clearly, all small printed pack text stays in its ORIGINAL GERMAN and softly out of focus — NEVER legible English health words on the pack. Never invent, add or duplicate any other product, tube, box, bottle or brush. STRICT COMPLIANCE (cosmetic-only, non-negotiable): never show or write gingivitis, periodontitis, gum disease, halitosis, reverses the condition, graphic bleeding gums close-up, bleeding, reduces bleeding, stops bleeding, stops gum bleeding, gum bleeding, soothes, soothes irritation, irritation, inflammation, reduces inflammation, anti-inflammatory, heals, calms, closes gum pockets, kills bacteria, kills the bacteria, clinically proven, clinically tested, clinical trial, gum health, oral health, dental health, healthy tissue, healthy gums, dentist approved, dentist recommended, peroxide, bleach; never a medical cross, never a disease or treatment claim, never "clinically proven", never a doctor endorsement unless the reference's equivalent line was explicitly rewritten by the art director. If a competitor line would breach this, keep its size/position but soften the wording to a cosmetic feel/benefit. TITLE CASE ALL HEADERS (Quan's #1 header rule, never break): the headline AND every sub-headline are written in Title Case — capitalise every significant word; small words (a, an, the, and, or, in, of, to, for, with, on, at) stay lowercase unless they are the first word. This overrides the reference ad's own casing (even if their headline is in sentence case). Body lines and fine print keep the casing given in the changes. TEXT RULES: all text in Australian English, spelled exactly as given, crisp and legible at thumbnail size. Do NOT add any headline, badge, trust seal, star row, review, CTA pill, URL, price or logo that the reference does not have. Do NOT remove any element the reference has. OUTPUT FORMAT — ALWAYS 4:5 PORTRAIT (1080×1350), even when the reference is square or landscape (Quan 15/10/2026, never break). Keep the reference's element order and styling top to bottom, and use the extra vertical space to make the main elements BIGGER — never add new elements, never leave an empty band. 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, full-bleed edge to edge. Output ONE finished image.
